row.evidence: Ease's pricing page lists three broker subscription levels (Pro, Agency, Enterprise) with "Single sign-on" only on Enterprise and no provisioning feature; its SSO page says "Ease partners with Okta for SSO, and includes it as a part of our Enterprise pricing package", and a site search for SCIM returns no results.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM. The site now says "Ease is now owned by Employee Navigator!". Brokers buy Pro (up to 2,000 employees, 3 agency users), Agency (unlimited employees, 6 agency users) or Enterprise (unlimited employees, 10 agency users); prices are not shown and are flat by tier, not PEPM. SSO (via Okta) is Enterprise-only. Add-ons: EaseHR $1 PEPM for brokers / $2 PEPM for employers, ACA forms $6 per employee per form per year, payroll integrations typically $0 to $1.50 PEPM. The help centre (help.ease.com) requires sign-in, so no public SCIM or admin API docs could be checked. Employee data sync is via payroll integrations (ADP, Paycor, Paylocity and others), not identity providers.

scim.notes: Absence: no SCIM mention on pricing, SSO, security or FAQ pages; site search for 'scim' returns no results.

user_api.notes: No public API reference. developer.ease.com, developers.ease.com and api.ease.com redirect to the secure.ease.com login. Payroll and carrier integrations exist but are partner-built and not a customer user-management API.

okta.notes: Ease says it partners with Okta for SSO. okta.com/integrations/ease/ returns 404; no OIN listing found.

fallbacks.other_sync: Payroll integrations (ADP Workforce Now, Heartland, Paycor, Paylocity, RUN Powered by ADP) sync deduction and demographic information
